programme.title: Beathaichean a’ Bocadaich
programme.desc: Tha Sophie a’ coimhead tron phrosbaig sheunta aice airson faicinn ciamar a bhios beathaichean a’ bocadaich. Tha i ag ionnsachadh mar a bhios diofar bheathaichean a’ gluasad agus cuide ri a caraidean, tha i a’ cruthachadh dannsa. An-diugh, danns coltach ri crogall agus leumadair! Sophie looks through her magic binoculars to find out how animals boogie. She learns how different animals dance and, along with her friends, creates a dance using animal movements. Join her and dance like a crocodile and a dolphin!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Ann an saoghal nan Clangairean, dìreach mar an tè againn fhèin, tha rudan do-chreidsinneach a’ tachairt, ach feumaidh d’ inntinn bhith ceasnachail gu leòr airson mothachadh dhaibh In the Clanger world, just like our own, unbelievable things happen but your mind has to be open enough to notice them.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Planaid nan Clangairean, far am bi rudan math a’ tachairt - agus an corra mhearachd cuideachd! Dè an rud deàlrach a tha sin? Tha Am Màidsear ’son rannsachadh a dhèanamh. Planet Clangairean, where good things happen, and the odd mistake happens too! What’s that shining thing? Màidsear wants to investigate!

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Joy Dunlop a’ leughadh Chan eil Madadh-allaidh Mòr Dona san Stòiridh Seo. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Lou Carter, a dhealbhachadh le Deborah Allwright agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart. Joy Dunlop reads Chan eil Madadh-allaidh Mòr Dona san Stòiridh Seo by Lou Carter, illustrated by Deborah Allwright and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Tha Sana ’son a bhith na gruagaire agus tha i ’son stoidhle-gruaig ùr a chruthachadh do Mhiyoko, a seanmhair. Tha Miyoko air a bhith a’ fulang le gualainn ghoirt ’s tha Sana airson togail a thoirt dhi. Ciamar a thèid leatha? Sana would like to be a hairdresser and wants to create a new hairstyle for her grandmother. Nan Miyoko has been suffering from a sore shoulder and Sana would like to cheer her up. How will she get on?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha Belle is Sebastian cho treun 's a bha ’ad a-riamh nuair tha Mitch, an sreapadair cliùiteach, san sgìre. Belle and Sebastian are as brave as ever when the famous climber, Mitch, is in the area.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha an tuathanach air a' chiad duais a ghlèidheadh agus chan urrainn dha an naidheachd a chreidsinn! Feumaidh e an tiocaid a chumail sàbhailte gu madainn is tha sin an urra ri Bitzer. Gu mi-fhortanach chan e Bitzer an cù ceart airson na h-obrach seo! An dùil an lorg e an tiocaid no na chaill e fortan an tuathanaich? The farmer can't believe his luck - he has a winning ticket! He just needs to keep it safe until morning and there's only one dog for the job! Unfortunately, Bitzer is a hopeless guard dog. Can he rescue the winning ticket, or has he lost the farmer's fortune?

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Sa phrògram seo seallaidh i dhut dòigh sgoinneil air coltas eadar-dhealaichte a thoirt air do chuid aodaich! Choirstaidh presents from her studio A’ Chùil to show you a great way of changing up your clothes.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Leis mar a chaidh sgrùdadh na sgoile an-uiridh, tha bòrd na sgoile air Leas-Cheannard ùr, Ms Dallas, a thoirt a-steach gus sùil ghèir a chumail air Mgr Mackle. Bidh sinn a' coinneachadh ri tidsearean ùra agus ri feadhainn air a bheil sinn air eòlas a chuir roimhe. After last year’s school inspection, the school board has appointed a new deputy head, Ms Dallas, to keep an eye on Mr Mackle. We meet new teachers alongside some recognisable personalities.

programme.title: Slighe Naoimh Cuithbeirt/St Cuthbert's Way

With lobster season looming, captains fight fatigue and the elements to fill crab and scallop quotas before time - and luck - run out.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by his daughter Ruth as they go to sea on a spectacular summer's day. Along the way they encounter a large pod of dolphins who take great delight in racing their small boat. Then it’s time for fishing and chat about the formative role of fishing in Ruth’s upbringing. Anns an dàrna prògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha nighean Aonghais, Rut, còmhla ris agus iad aig muir air latha samhraidh eireachdail. Air an t-slighe, coinnichidh iad ri buidheann leumadairean-mara a tha dannsa mun eathar. Às dèidh sin, tha an t-àm ann airson iasgach agus còmhradh mun bhuaidh a bh’ aig iasgach air beatha Ruth.

programme.title: She-Wolves: England's Early Queens
programme.desc: In the medieval and Tudor world there was no question in people's minds about the order of God's creation - men ruled and women didn't. A king was a warrior who literally fought to win power then battled to keep it. Yet despite everything that stood in their way, a handful of extraordinary women did attempt to rule medieval and Tudor England. In this series, historian Dr Helen Castor explores seven queens who challenged male power, the fierce reactions they provoked and whether the term 'she wolves' was deserved. Eight hundred years ago, Matilda came within a hair's breadth of being the first woman to be crowned queen of England in her own right. Castor explores how Matilda reached this point and why her bid for the throne ultimately failed. Her daughter-in-law Eleanor of Aquitaine was an equally formidable woman. Despite being remembered as the queen of courtly love, in reality during her long life she divorced one king and married another, only to lead a rebellion against him. She only finally achieved the power she craved in her seventies.

programme.title: Walking With...
programme.desc: Broadcaster Kate Garraway goes for an invigorating walk along the edge of the Cotswold Hills. As she passes through the patch where Kate first cut her teeth as a reporter, she takes time to appreciate the stunning landscapes. From the panoramic viewpoint of Painswick Beacon, Kate descends through beech woods to the village of Upton St Leonards, soaking up the sounds of nature as she goes. From there she climbs Cooper’s Hill and wanders down to the church at Great Witcombe. Kate relishes the chance to have nothing to do but take in the 'joy and rhythm of the countryside' as she crosses the gentle, rolling hills with just a 360-degree camera for company. Along the way, she meets local craftspeople who are inspired by the ‘living theatre’ of the landscapes. Kate finds her natural surroundings a source of inspiration and resilience as she reflects on a year of challenges and change.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: At the home of Scottish football, Glasgow’s Hampden Park stadium, Michael admires the oldest football trophy in the world and hears how the 'passing game' was born there. From Scotland’s busiest railway station, the splendid Glasgow Central, Michael heads to the M8 motorway to see 16 lanes of traffic slicing through the city centre. At the Kelvingrove Art Gallery, Michael hears how, after the Second World War, artist Joan Eardley set up a studio amid the tenements of Townhead and painted children from Glasgow’s slums. Michael finishes this leg of the journey in the planned, modernist new town of Cumbernauld, where he hears about the utopian ideals that shaped its design and architecture.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his postwar Scottish railway adventure, this time from Glasgow to the capital, Edinburgh. At Pollok Country Park in Glasgow, Michael joins a women’s running club, the Bellahouston Harriers, for a warm-up session. In parkland above the pits en route to Cuningar Loop, he finds Glasgow’s geoenergy observatory, where the British Geological Society is researching how mine water heated naturally underground can be harnessed to save energy. At Livingston North, Michael investigates a puzzling incident in 1979 in Dechmont Woods. And at Edinburgh’s famous 12th-century castle, he discovers the origins of a spectacle that has attracted tourists from far and wide since 1950, the Edinburgh Tattoo.

programme.title: Walking With...
programme.desc: Famous for waking up the nation on Radio One and his afternoon drive-time show, DJ and presenter Nick Grimshaw heads to the north east of England for a stroll through a fascinating landscape. Exploring historic areas of Warkworth and Amble in Northumberland, Nick begins his walk at first light, dipping his toes in the sea for a refreshing wake-me-up along the beach. Crossing sand dunes and an ancient river, Nick heads for the streets of Warkworth and reflects on the importance of family life, including the positive influence of his late father. Nick talks about recognising his sexuality as he was growing up - including questioning what ‘being gay’ would actually mean. Taking the short boat crossing to the extraordinary Warkworth Hermitage - a retreat carved from a sandstone cliff - Nick talks about the benefits meditation has brought to his life. As Nick approaches the end of his walk, the conversation turns to the future. He talks passionately about his desire to start his own family with his partner. Revitalised after his seven-mile walk, Nick enjoys the sunset at Amble pier and vows to return to Northumberland.

programme.title: A Timewatch Guide
programme.desc: Historian Dan Snow explores the greatest maritime archaeology project in British history - the Mary Rose. Using 40 years of BBC archive footage Dan charts how the Mary Rose was discovered, excavated and eventually raised, and what the latest research has revealed about this iconic ship and her crew. Dan also investigates how the Mary Rose project helped create modern underwater archaeology, examining the techniques, challenges and triumphs of the divers and archaeologists involved.

programme.title: The Magic of Mushrooms
programme.desc: Professor Richard Fortey delves into the fascinating and normally hidden kingdom of fungi. From their spectacular birth, through a secretive underground life to their final explosive death, Richard reveals a remarkable world that few of us understand or even realise exists - yet all life on earth depends on it. In a specially built mushroom lab, with the help of mycologist Dr Patrick Hickey and some state-of-the-art technology, Richard brings to life the secret world of mushrooms as never seen before and reveals the spectacular abilities of fungi to break down waste and sustain new plant life, keeping our planet alive. Beyond the lab, Richard travels across Britain and beyond to show us the biggest, fastest and most deadly organisms on the planet - all of them fungi. He reveals their almost magical powers that have world-changing potential - opening up new frontiers in science, medicine and technology.

programme.title: Play for Today
programme.desc: Second series of the long-running strand of one-off dramas first broadcast in 1971/72.

programme.title: Private Life of a Masterpiece
programme.desc: Whistler's portrait of his elderly Puritan mother is one of the most satirised paintings of all time. Yet when his sombre masterpiece was first unveiled, it was seen as a radical departure from the sentimental images beloved of the Victorians, and which Whistler loathed. How did the portrait, born of Whistler's complex relationship with his mother, change the course of painting so drastically?

programme.title: She-Wolves: England's Early Queens
programme.desc: In the medieval and Tudor world there was no question in people's minds about the order of God's creation - men ruled and women didn't. A king was a warrior who literally fought to win power then battled to keep it. Yet despite everything that stood in their way, a handful of extraordinary women did attempt to rule medieval and Tudor England. In this series, historian Dr Helen Castor explores seven queens who challenged male power, the fierce reactions they provoked and whether the term 'she wolves' was deserved. Eight hundred years ago, Matilda came within a hair's breadth of being the first woman to be crowned queen of England in her own right. Castor explores how Matilda reached this point and why her bid for the throne ultimately failed. Her daughter-in-law Eleanor of Aquitaine was an equally formidable woman. programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate 25 years together on Animal Park, looking back at some of the animals, keepers and unforgettable moments they have shared, while new stories continue to unfold across the park. Following the loss of one of their brothers, the park's African wild dogs are struggling to find their place within the pack. With the social hierarchy unsettled, the keepers closely monitor their behaviour and introduce a special enrichment challenge, hoping it will help strengthen the bonds between the remaining dogs. As part of the anniversary celebrations, Ben and Kate revisit the remarkable life of Nico, the park's much-loved silverback gorilla. From his extraordinary bond with keeper Mark Tye to the illness that threatened his life and the legacy he left behind, they reflect on one of Animal Park's most unforgettable residents. Elsewhere, Megan discovers what the park's new maned wolves make of some unusual treats, while an extraordinary scientific project could see the legacy of beloved lioness Malaika helping to shape future exploration on Mars.

programme.title: The Moment of Proof
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his flat, and he has been robbed. Police trace the last person he called on his mobile phone. But when toxicology tests reveal the victim died after drinking a deadly cocktail, police are under pressure to find the evidence to prove their prime suspect is a killer. And in another case, police trying to crack open an organised drugs gang operating out of a tandoori takeaway hit the jackpot when they discover the owner is renting a warehouse in a neighbouring county.

programme.title: Expert Witness
programme.desc: A forensic scientist and a fingerprint expert identify a killer nearly 60 years after the crime, and a plant scientist helps expose a fraudster in a fake tea-growing operation.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A flashback to 2016, when Dion visited a former police station in Birmingham that wasn’t your usual auction lot. Things are a bit more conventional for him in Liverpool at a three-bedroom mid-terrace, but there’s nothing 'standard' about Jacqui’s property in Hertfordshire.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Our two teams are bargain-hunting at an antiques fair in the historic market town of Newbury, where Caroline Hawley also chats to fairgoers to see if they can guess our mystery item. Our teams, both mother-and-daughter combinations, are Katie and Eden, guided by Raj Bisram, and Ni and Beth, aided by Stephanie Connell. Tasked to find an item you would find on a dining table, the reds have their eyes set on a silver-plated cloche, but will this reveal a profit! Meanwhile, Stephanie Connell helps the blues hunt for an item with a connection to birds as they have their eyes set on a pair of metal garden bird ornaments, but will they fly? As the clock counts down, can the reds strike an excellent deal on a Maurice Lacroix wristwatch, and the blues are left to make an important decision. Down the road in Newbury, Caroline meets auctioneer Thomas Forrester to get his estimates on the teams’ items before they go under Thomas’s gavel, but how will they do?

programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: A British rookie cop tackles crime during her first day on duty in paradise, and a traffic patrol officer tries to keep his learner driver son safe on Bermuda’s roads.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Australia
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels south from the dry outback into the Riverina, a region that defies Australia’s reputation as the world’s most arid inhabited continent.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton is exploring Herefordshire and Gloucestershire, helping a couple make the move from Germany to the British countryside. Alistair shows them a fantastic mystery house – a smallholding which comes complete with Tom, Barbara, Margo and Jerry, four goats who are already living the good life on the property. Alistair also meets up with a writer who exchanged London life for Herefordshire’s green calm and now shares her lovely, inspiring home with a menagerie of animals.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: With JB and Lauren’s help, Tanya lets go of her parents’ treasured items to fund a dream trip to India, thus honouring her father’s memory and reconnecting with her heritage.

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: The brainy quiz returns - but this time host Alexander Armstrong is joined by co-host Gyles Brandreth. As always, contestants try to score as few points as possible by plumbing the depths of their general knowledge to come up with the answers no-one else could think of.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate 25 years together on Animal Park, looking back at some of the animals, keepers and unforgettable moments they have shared, while new stories continue to unfold across the park. Following the loss of one of their brothers, the park's African wild dogs are struggling to find their place within the pack. With the social hierarchy unsettled, the keepers closely monitor their behaviour and introduce a special enrichment challenge, hoping it will help strengthen the bonds between the remaining dogs. As part of the anniversary celebrations, Ben and Kate revisit the remarkable life of Nico, the park's much-loved silverback gorilla. From his extraordinary bond with keeper Mark Tye to the illness that threatened his life and the legacy he left behind, they reflect on one of Animal Park's most unforgettable residents. Elsewhere, Megan discovers what the park's new maned wolves make of some unusual treats, while an extraordinary scientific project could see the legacy of beloved lioness Malaika helping to shape future exploration on Mars.

And in another case, police trying to crack open an organised drugs gang operating out of a tandoori takeaway hit the jackpot when they discover the owner is renting a warehouse in a neighbouring county.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Our two teams are bargain-hunting at an antiques fair in the historic market town of Newbury, where Caroline Hawley also chats to fairgoers to see if they can guess our mystery item. Our teams, both mother-and-daughter combinations, are Katie and Eden, guided by Raj Bisram, and Ni and Beth, aided by Stephanie Connell. Tasked to find an item you would find on a dining table, the reds have their eyes set on a silver-plated cloche, but will this reveal a profit! Meanwhile, Stephanie Connell helps the blues hunt for an item with a connection to birds as they have their eyes set on a pair of metal garden bird ornaments, but will they fly? As the clock counts down, can the reds strike an excellent deal on a Maurice Lacroix wristwatch, and the blues are left to make an important decision. Down the road in Newbury, Caroline meets auctioneer Thomas Forrester to get his estimates on the teams’ items before they go under Thomas’s gavel, but how will they do?

programme.title: The Bidding Room

All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate 25 years together on Animal Park, looking back at some of the animals, keepers and unforgettable moments they have shared, while new stories continue to unfold across the park. Following the loss of one of their brothers, the park's African wild dogs are struggling to find their place within the pack. With the social hierarchy unsettled, the keepers closely monitor their behaviour and introduce a special enrichment challenge, hoping it will help strengthen the bonds between the remaining dogs. As part of the anniversary celebrations, Ben and Kate revisit the remarkable life of Nico, the park's much-loved silverback gorilla. From his extraordinary bond with keeper Mark Tye to the illness that threatened his life and the legacy he left behind, they reflect on one of Animal Park's most unforgettable residents. Elsewhere, Megan discovers what the park's new maned wolves make of some unusual treats, while an extraordinary scientific project could see the legacy of beloved lioness Malaika helping to shape future exploration on Mars.

programme.title: The Moment of Proof
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his flat, and he has been robbed. Police trace the last person he called on his mobile phone. And in another case, police trying to crack open an organised drugs gang operating out of a tandoori takeaway hit the jackpot when they discover the owner is renting a warehouse in a neighbouring county.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate 25 years together on Animal Park, looking back at some of the animals, keepers and unforgettable moments they have shared, while new stories continue to unfold across the park. Following the loss of one of their brothers, the park's African wild dogs are struggling to find their place within the pack. With the social hierarchy unsettled, the keepers closely monitor their behaviour and introduce a special enrichment challenge, hoping it will help strengthen the bonds between the remaining dogs. As part of the anniversary celebrations, Ben and Kate revisit the remarkable life of Nico, the park's much-loved silverback gorilla. From his extraordinary bond with keeper Mark Tye to the illness that threatened his life and the legacy he left behind, they reflect on one of Animal Park's most unforgettable residents. Elsewhere, Megan discovers what the park's new maned wolves make of some unusual treats, while an extraordinary scientific project could see the legacy of beloved lioness Malaika helping to shape future exploration on Mars.

programme.title: The Moment of Proof
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his flat, and he has been robbed. Police trace the last person he called on his mobile phone. But when toxicology tests reveal the victim died after drinking a deadly cocktail, police are under pressure to find the evidence to prove their prime suspect is a killer. And in another case, police trying to crack open an organised drugs gang operating out of a tandoori takeaway hit the jackpot when they discover the owner is renting a warehouse in a neighbouring county.

programme.title: Expert Witness
programme.desc: A forensic scientist and a fingerprint expert identify a killer nearly 60 years after the crime, and a plant scientist helps expose a fraudster in a fake tea-growing operation.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A flashback to 2016, when Dion visited a former police station in Birmingham that wasn’t your usual auction lot. Things are a bit more conventional for him in Liverpool at a three-bedroom mid-terrace, but there’s nothing 'standard' about Jacqui’s property in Hertfordshire.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Our two teams are bargain-hunting at an antiques fair in the historic market town of Newbury, where Caroline Hawley also chats to fairgoers to see if they can guess our mystery item. Our teams, both mother-and-daughter combinations, are Katie and Eden, guided by Raj Bisram, and Ni and Beth, aided by Stephanie Connell. Tasked to find an item you would find on a dining table, the reds have their eyes set on a silver-plated cloche, but will this reveal a profit! Meanwhile, Stephanie Connell helps the blues hunt for an item with a connection to birds as they have their eyes set on a pair of metal garden bird ornaments, but will they fly? As the clock counts down, can the reds strike an excellent deal on a Maurice Lacroix wristwatch, and the blues are left to make an important decision. Down the road in Newbury, Caroline meets auctioneer Thomas Forrester to get his estimates on the teams’ items before they go under Thomas’s gavel, but how will they do?

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate 25 years together on Animal Park, looking back at some of the animals, keepers and unforgettable moments they have shared, while new stories continue to unfold across the park. Following the loss of one of their brothers, the park's African wild dogs are struggling to find their place within the pack. With the social hierarchy unsettled, the keepers closely monitor their behaviour and introduce a special enrichment challenge, hoping it will help strengthen the bonds between the remaining dogs. As part of the anniversary celebrations, Ben and Kate revisit the remarkable life of Nico, the park's much-loved silverback gorilla. From his extraordinary bond with keeper Mark Tye to the illness that threatened his life and the legacy he left behind, they reflect on one of Animal Park's most unforgettable residents. Elsewhere, Megan discovers what the park's new maned wolves make of some unusual treats, while an extraordinary scientific project could see the legacy of beloved lioness Malaika helping to shape future exploration on Mars.

programme.title: The Moment of Proof
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his flat, and he has been robbed. Police trace the last person he called on his mobile phone. But when toxicology tests reveal the victim died after drinking a deadly cocktail, police are under pressure to find the evidence to prove their prime suspect is a killer. And in another case, police trying to crack open an organised drugs gang operating out of a tandoori takeaway hit the jackpot when they discover the owner is renting a warehouse in a neighbouring county.

programme.title: Expert Witness
programme.desc: A forensic scientist and a fingerprint expert identify a killer nearly 60 years after the crime, and a plant scientist helps expose a fraudster in a fake tea-growing operation.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A flashback to 2016, when Dion visited a former police station in Birmingham that wasn’t your usual auction lot. Things are a bit more conventional for him in Liverpool at a three-bedroom mid-terrace, but there’s nothing 'standard' about Jacqui’s property in Hertfordshire.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Our two teams are bargain-hunting at an antiques fair in the historic market town of Newbury, where Caroline Hawley also chats to fairgoers to see if they can guess our mystery item. Our teams, both mother-and-daughter combinations, are Katie and Eden, guided by Raj Bisram, and Ni and Beth, aided by Stephanie Connell. Tasked to find an item you would find on a dining table, the reds have their eyes set on a silver-plated cloche, but will this reveal a profit! Meanwhile, Stephanie Connell helps the blues hunt for an item with a connection to birds as they have their eyes set on a pair of metal garden bird ornaments, but will they fly? As the clock counts down, can the reds strike an excellent deal on a Maurice Lacroix wristwatch, and the blues are left to make an important decision. Down the road in Newbury, Caroline meets auctioneer Thomas Forrester to get his estimates on the teams’ items before they go under Thomas’s gavel, but how will they do?

programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate 25 years together on Animal Park, looking back at some of the animals, keepers and unforgettable moments they have shared, while new stories continue to unfold across the park. Following the loss of one of their brothers, the park's African wild dogs are struggling to find their place within the pack. With the social hierarchy unsettled, the keepers closely monitor their behaviour and introduce a special enrichment challenge, hoping it will help strengthen the bonds between the remaining dogs. As part of the anniversary celebrations, Ben and Kate revisit the remarkable life of Nico, the park's much-loved silverback gorilla. From his extraordinary bond with keeper Mark Tye to the illness that threatened his life and the legacy he left behind, they reflect on one of Animal Park's most unforgettable residents. Elsewhere, Megan discovers what the park's new maned wolves make of some unusual treats, while an extraordinary scientific project could see the legacy of beloved lioness Malaika helping to shape future exploration on Mars.

programme.title: The Moment of Proof
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his flat, and he has been robbed. Police trace the last person he called on his mobile phone. But when toxicology tests reveal the victim died after drinking a deadly cocktail, police are under pressure to find the evidence to prove their prime suspect is a killer. And in another case, police trying to crack open an organised drugs gang operating out of a tandoori takeaway hit the jackpot when they discover the owner is renting a warehouse in a neighbouring county.

programme.title: Expert Witness
programme.desc: A forensic scientist and a fingerprint expert identify a killer nearly 60 years after the crime, and a plant scientist helps expose a fraudster in a fake tea-growing operation.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A flashback to 2016, when Dion visited a former police station in Birmingham that wasn’t your usual auction lot. Things are a bit more conventional for him in Liverpool at a three-bedroom mid-terrace, but there’s nothing 'standard' about Jacqui’s property in Hertfordshire.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Our two teams are bargain-hunting at an antiques fair in the historic market town of Newbury, where Caroline Hawley also chats to fairgoers to see if they can guess our mystery item. Our teams, both mother-and-daughter combinations, are Katie and Eden, guided by Raj Bisram, and Ni and Beth, aided by Stephanie Connell. Tasked to find an item you would find on a dining table, the reds have their eyes set on a silver-plated cloche, but will this reveal a profit! Meanwhile, Stephanie Connell helps the blues hunt for an item with a connection to birds as they have their eyes set on a pair of metal garden bird ornaments, but will they fly? As the clock counts down, can the reds strike an excellent deal on a Maurice Lacroix wristwatch, and the blues are left to make an important decision. Down the road in Newbury, Caroline meets auctioneer Thomas Forrester to get his estimates on the teams’ items before they go under Thomas’s gavel, but how will they do?

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton is exploring Herefordshire and Gloucestershire, helping a couple make the move from Germany to the British countryside. Alistair shows them a fantastic mystery house – a smallholding which comes complete with Tom, Barbara, Margo and Jerry, four goats who are already living the good life on the property. Alistair also meets up with a writer who exchanged London life for Herefordshire’s green calm and now shares her lovely, inspiring home with a menagerie of animals.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate 25 years together on Animal Park, looking back at some of the animals, keepers and unforgettable moments they have shared, while new stories continue to unfold across the park. Following the loss of one of their brothers, the park's African wild dogs are struggling to find their place within the pack. With the social hierarchy unsettled, the keepers closely monitor their behaviour and introduce a special enrichment challenge, hoping it will help strengthen the bonds between the remaining dogs. As part of the anniversary celebrations, Ben and Kate revisit the remarkable life of Nico, the park's much-loved silverback gorilla. From his extraordinary bond with keeper Mark Tye to the illness that threatened his life and the legacy he left behind, they reflect on one of Animal Park's most unforgettable residents. Elsewhere, Megan discovers what the park's new maned wolves make of some unusual treats, while an extraordinary scientific project could see the legacy of beloved lioness Malaika helping to shape future exploration on Mars.

programme.title: The Moment of Proof
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his flat, and he has been robbed. Police trace the last person he called on his mobile phone. But when toxicology tests reveal the victim died after drinking a deadly cocktail, police are under pressure to find the evidence to prove their prime suspect is a killer. And in another case, police trying to crack open an organised drugs gang operating out of a tandoori takeaway hit the jackpot when they discover the owner is renting a warehouse in a neighbouring county.

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: After the attack on his best friends and threats against his sister, Mobeen is armed, dangerous and out for revenge. But can he solve his problems without any bloodshed, or will they land him deeper in the criminal world he’s trying to escape. His attempts to make up for past mistakes see him pulled back into the world of unhinged crime boss Uncle Khan. Owing money to Khan (with deadly consequences if he doesn’t pay him back), Mobeen struggles to undertake his criminal orders under the watchful eye of Khan’s useless nephew Nav. Now living at Uncle Shady’s 'safe house', can Mobeen keep his family safe whilst staying out of jail? Or will the dark path he is being forced down lead to him paying the ultimate price?

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: Mobeen tries to do a good deed by helping out at the local food bank, but juggling this with strict orders from Uncle Khan to launder money could leave him with a deadly debt that is impossible to pay.

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: Mobeen and Aks must demonstrate their commitment to a good cause to prevent her being excluded from school. This involves attending the funeral of Mobeen’s former teacher - but when drug a deal goes wrong at the church, Mobeen has bigger things to worry about.

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: With a hit out on Officer Harper, Mobeen steps in to try to save his life and take him out of the firing line. Eight and Nate must stall Harper’s assassin long enough for Mobeen and Harper to escape through the woods.

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen

programme.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
programme.desc: We’ve travelled to the heart of the south Wales valleys to Pontypridd and Y Muni, a multipurpose, fully accessible live music and comedy venue. Louie McLean, Suri Ashish, Sarah Roberts, Paul Hilleard and Josh Harvey as Bernard Guff will take to the stage in a bid to impress our judges and book their place in the final. Welsh comedian Kiri Pritchard-McLean is our host for this heat. Joining her is our panel of judges, actor and comic Spencer Jones, and Hannah Moulder, producer of the award-winning Juice on BBC Three. Head judge Babatunde Aleshe completes the trio. It’s not going to be easy for them to pick a winner from the five new comics performing. With only five minutes of stage time, the sets are jam-packed with jokes and cutting-edge material, but only one can go through to the grand final in November at Birmingham’s historic Alexandra Theatre.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: An oddball family make a brave, but bungling, attempt to save their failing funeral home in the sleepy Scottish fishing village of Kincully. Archie, having recently inherited the floundering family business from his domineering dad, is determined to prove himself. His sister Moira, the company mortician, and hearse driver Cousin Ron are looking to Archie to prevent A Better Place Funeral Home from falling into the hands of Sympathy Plus, a corporate funeral chain run by the power-hungry Eileen. Archie is also living in the shadow of his late father - literally. He keeps him in a great big freezer on the landing. With time running out, Archie hatches a plan to keep hold of the family business. Will Archie’s scheme work? Or will A Better Place fall prey to Eileen’s growing empire?

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Adventurer Steve Backshall and the Deadly 60 team pack their cold weather gear and head north to Alaska. They battle for days and nights in the freezing conditions of the frozen tundra, hoping to find polar bears to add to the list. They are rewarded with a rare sighting of a wolverine and some cheeky Arctic foxes. Steve has heard of a place where thousands of bald eagles arrive every year to feed on the spawning salmon. Keen to see them first-hand, he heads up one of the freezing rivers to get a closer look. programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson celebrates the 50th birthday of the Jaguar E-type by driving a modern half-a-million pound interpretation of this classic sports car before putting on a typically low-key birthday party involving live music, classic fighter planes and a group of Royal Marines. programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: After the attack on his best friends and threats against his sister, Mobeen is armed, dangerous and out for revenge. But can he solve his problems without any bloodshed, or will they land him deeper in the criminal world he’s trying to escape. His attempts to make up for past mistakes see him pulled back into the world of unhinged crime boss Uncle Khan. Owing money to Khan (with deadly consequences if he doesn’t pay him back), Mobeen struggles to undertake his criminal orders under the watchful eye of Khan’s useless nephew Nav. Now living at Uncle Shady’s 'safe house', can Mobeen keep his family safe whilst staying out of jail? Or will the dark path he is being forced down lead to him paying the ultimate price?

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen

programme.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
programme.desc: We’ve travelled to the heart of the south Wales valleys to Pontypridd and Y Muni, a multipurpose, fully accessible live music and comedy venue. Louie McLean, Suri Ashish, Sarah Roberts, Paul Hilleard and Josh Harvey as Bernard Guff will take to the stage in a bid to impress our judges and book their place in the final. Welsh comedian Kiri Pritchard-McLean is our host for this heat. Joining her is our panel of judges, actor and comic Spencer Jones, and Hannah Moulder, producer of the award-winning Juice on BBC Three. Head judge Babatunde Aleshe completes the trio. It’s not going to be easy for them to pick a winner from the five new comics performing. With only five minutes of stage time, the sets are jam-packed with jokes and cutting-edge material, but only one can go through to the grand final in November at Birmingham’s historic Alexandra Theatre.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: An oddball family make a brave, but bungling, attempt to save their failing funeral home in the sleepy Scottish fishing village of Kincully. Archie, having recently inherited the floundering family business from his domineering dad, is determined to prove himself. His sister Moira, the company mortician, and hearse driver Cousin Ron are looking to Archie to prevent A Better Place Funeral Home from falling into the hands of Sympathy Plus, a corporate funeral chain run by the power-hungry Eileen. Archie is also living in the shadow of his late father - literally. He keeps him in a great big freezer on the landing. With time running out, Archie hatches a plan to keep hold of the family business. Will Archie’s scheme work? Or will A Better Place fall prey to Eileen’s growing empire?

programme.title: My Epic Camel Adventure with Gordon Buchanan
programme.desc: Gordon Buchanan takes an epic journey across the Gobi Desert on one of the world’s most iconic, yet least understood, animals – camels. Starting in the west of Mongolia, Gordeon crosses blistering sand dunes, endless rocky plains and the treacherous Bumbat Mountain, with only his camels for company. If he is to succeed, he must befriend the camels, learn as much as he can about them, and try to win their trust and respect. Without that, the journey and his survival are in question. Naming camels isn’t something that nomads would do, but as his relationship with them strengthens, he decides to name them Squeaks and Chewy. They are lucky enough to meet some of the other inhabitants of this seemingly desolate landscape, such as wolves, saiga antelopes and yaks. But will he be lucky enough to catch sight of the most endangered bear on the planet – the Gobi Bear? Spending time with different nomads also gives Gordon time to reflect on the appeal of the traditional nomadic way of life, and his own modern existence. Ultimately, he discovers how camels have evolved in the most unusual ways to survive and prosper in one of the most hostile environments on the planet.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Sonali Shah is in the Peak District helping Andrew, and his faithful dog Edna, swap Amsterdam for a home in the UK’s first National Park. Supported by his big sister, and with a budget of £375,000, he’s hoping for a characterful cottage with spectacular scenery. Property picks include homes boasting fantastic views and a Mystery House which comes with something special that should appeal to his sibling! Whilst there, Sonali also discovers how local woodlands are being transformed, as young native trees are creating a greener future following the impact of ash dieback.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: In Scotland, Izzie and Robin help Anne declutter her crammed flat to raise funds for a campervan adventure. But can a dishevelled Hindu deity bring them the fortunes they need?

programme.title: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
programme.desc: On board a sleek Shinkansen bullet train, Michael arrives in Tokyo, one of the greatest cities on earth, with a population of 37 million in the metropolitan area. He begins by exploring the ornate Akasaka Palace, built in 1909 by Emperor Meiji for his son, the crown prince Yoshihito. He’s surprised to find that, with its neo-baroque architecture and impressive fountains, it looks more than a little British. In the fashionable district of Ginza, Michael journeys underground to ride the Tokyo metro. He’s intrigued by the catchy jingles played at each station and meets one of the composers behind 300 of the tunes. Stopping off in the neighbourhood of Ueno to explore the famous Ameyoko street market, Michael travels to the east of the city to marvel at the Tokyo Skytree, standing at over 630 meters high. After a giddy ride to the top to take in the views, he learns how it was designed to be earthquake-proof.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo embarks on a stunning railway adventure through the western Mediterranean islands of Sardinia and Corsica, beginning in Sardinia’s capital, Cagliari. Michael delves into the city's Roman past and experiences warm Sardinian hospitality with a taste of the traditional myrtle liqueur. He discovers the legacy of Eleanora de Arborea, the pioneering medieval ruler who shaped Sardinia’s laws, and listens to the unique sounds of the Sardinian language, Sardo, and its haunting choral singing. Travelling west to Porto Flavia, he marvels at an extraordinary feat of engineering, an underground railway and tunnel which revolutionised the transport of the island’s prized minerals to the Mediterranean.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Kemah Bob, JJ Chalmers, Kevin Clifton and Victoria Derbyshire take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games kitchen composter?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp hosts this quiz show with sidekick Sarah Greene where contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers will stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: With Storm Eunice - and its 100 mph winds - battering the south coast, the Portsmouth crew have to decide whether they can even launch to a windsurfer in trouble. Once they’re on the water, the situation escalates when it’s reported that the casualty doesn’t have his diabetes medication with him. In Skerries, on the east coast of Ireland, a husband watches on as his wife struggles on her kayak. When the crew race to her rescue, they discover her in the water and close to exhaustion. The Exmouth crew find themselves in danger when they attempt to rescue a female wing foiler who’s trapped in the surf line. And in Sussex, Selsey’s all-weather lifeboat faces a real challenge in rescuing a yacht with rigging failure out in the English Channel.

If he is to succeed, he must befriend the camels, learn as much as he can about them, and try to win their trust and respect. Without that, the journey and his survival are in question. Naming camels isn’t something that nomads would do, but as his relationship with them strengthens, he decides to name them Squeaks and Chewy. They are lucky enough to meet some of the other inhabitants of this seemingly desolate landscape, such as wolves, saiga antelopes and yaks. But will he be lucky enough to catch sight of the most endangered bear on the planet – the Gobi Bear? Spending time with different nomads also gives Gordon time to reflect on the appeal of the traditional nomadic way of life, and his own modern existence. Ultimately, he discovers how camels have evolved in the most unusual ways to survive and prosper in one of the most hostile environments on the planet.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Sonali Shah is in the Peak District helping Andrew, and his faithful dog Edna, swap Amsterdam for a home in the UK’s first National Park. Supported by his big sister, and with a budget of £375,000, he’s hoping for a characterful cottage with spectacular scenery. Property picks include homes boasting fantastic views and a Mystery House which comes with something special that should appeal to his sibling! Whilst there, Sonali also discovers how local woodlands are being transformed, as young native trees are creating a greener future following the impact of ash dieback.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: In Scotland, Izzie and Robin help Anne declutter her crammed flat to raise funds for a campervan adventure. But can a dishevelled Hindu deity bring them the fortunes they need?

programme.title: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
programme.desc: On board a sleek Shinkansen bullet train, Michael arrives in Tokyo, one of the greatest cities on earth, with a population of 37 million in the metropolitan area. He begins by exploring the ornate Akasaka Palace, built in 1909 by Emperor Meiji for his son, the crown prince Yoshihito. He’s surprised to find that, with its neo-baroque architecture and impressive fountains, it looks more than a little British. In the fashionable district of Ginza, Michael journeys underground to ride the Tokyo metro. He’s intrigued by the catchy jingles played at each station and meets one of the composers behind 300 of the tunes. Stopping off in the neighbourhood of Ueno to explore the famous Ameyoko street market, Michael travels to the east of the city to marvel at the Tokyo Skytree, standing at over 630 meters high. After a giddy ride to the top to take in the views, he learns how it was designed to be earthquake-proof.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo embarks on a stunning railway adventure through the western Mediterranean islands of Sardinia and Corsica, beginning in Sardinia’s capital, Cagliari. Michael delves into the city's Roman past and experiences warm Sardinian hospitality with a taste of the traditional myrtle liqueur. He discovers the legacy of Eleanora de Arborea, the pioneering medieval ruler who shaped Sardinia’s laws, and listens to the unique sounds of the Sardinian language, Sardo, and its haunting choral singing. Travelling west to Porto Flavia, he marvels at an extraordinary feat of engineering, an underground railway and tunnel which revolutionised the transport of the island’s prized minerals to the Mediterranean.

programme.desc: To prove she can be selfless, Cheese begins granting wishes. However, when a rival shows up to do the same, Cheese loses sight of her goal as she tries to remain number one!

programme.title: Horrible Science
programme.desc: Mary Ploppins soothes those digestive ills, Dr Big Brain tries banana power, and Einstein reacts to Tim Peake. Fred Sirieix guest stars.

programme.title: Gladiators: Epic Pranks
programme.desc: Nitro hires a fake image guru and, with help from the Gladiator producers, tells Viper and Phantom they need new looks as a prancing unicorn and a lassoing cowboy!

programme.title: Bro's in Control
programme.desc: Callum's pitting his Big Bro Adam against best mate Joe in this hilarious competition made up of funny, gross and gungy challenges. Who'll take the win and who will take a spin on the Wheel of Doom? It’s all up to Callum so they’ll need to impress him! When Joe and Adam open their front doors to find a 20m high crane outside, they know Little Bro Callum’s up to something! He’s challenged them to an epic Big Drop contest… with mum’s vase and their own phones. Which precious items will survive the drop, and how can watermelon and a gunge pool protect them? Once that’s sorted, it’s onto building gigantic hats with everyday objects in a bid to avoid Callum’s forfeit Wheel of Doom!

programme.title: Jamie Johnson FC
programme.desc: Hawx fan Jordan dreams of playing in the futsal tournament at the Academy. Meanwhile, Hawx players are pitted against each other, and Charlie faces a difficult decision.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Jamie Johnson FC
programme.desc: As the team prepare for the opening match of the Global Youth Cup, Baz takes matters into his own hands – with explosive consequences!

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: As Liko settles in on the Brave Olivine, the Fuecoco, who lives on the ship, goes missing!

programme.title: Taffy

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Shaun steps in a can of red paint, and his resulting red hoof makes him a style icon on the farm. Before long, the rest of the flock try their own new looks and soon steal the limelight. As the outfits become more and more outrageous, Shaun wonders if less might sometimes be more.

programme.title: Dennis & Gnasher Unleashed!
programme.desc: Dennis and his mates rebel against an outbreak of unfair fun-killing rules that are being imposed on Beanotown.

programme.title: Dennis & Gnasher Unleashed!

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings get a magical Mayan disc that transforms them into mutants.

The Go Jetters and other tourists now find their gondola rides blocked by roads and concrete.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Brinicle invites Pancake onto his radio show but is cross when his accidental burps prove a hit. Pancake soon discovers that fame as ‘burping guy’ has its downsides.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: When Gadabout and Pearl lose the cure for Madam Dragon’s missing flame, Zog helps them work together to assist his former teacher.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: The town’s ferris wheel is stuck, so Mojo and Bo have to get it moving. But they do their job too well, because the wheel rolls away, forcing Mojo and Bo to chase it down.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'I couldn't put the lolly back because it was licked, so I said sorry to Padget.' Bing helps Flop do the shopping at Padget's shop, but while Flop is paying, Bing finds a strawberry lolly that he can't resist putting in his pocket. When Flop sees Bing licking the lolly on the way home, they have to decide what to do.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘eyes’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a brown, blue, bright and shady eyes. Dee comforts a friend with crying eyes, and we come across some superhero eyes! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It’s Maddie’s first day at chess club, and she’s a little lonely because Mum can’t come with her. But she soon meets a cool new friend, who helps her settle in. Before long, that desert island feeling turns into a tropical paradise.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Kitty wants to experience the way Sasha bounces everywhere. The Piggy Builders create an egg-shaped vehicle for Kitty. Wilf makes it go wild, and the Piggy Builders have to find a way to stop it!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a man polish a suit of armour. As he is polishing, the man drops the cloth inside the suit of armour. He cannot reach it and goes off to get another cloth, taking the helmet with him. Great BigHoo manages to fall inside the armour and Toodloo jumps in after him - Chickedy and Chick soon follow! What fun will the Twirlywoos have in the suit of armour? Back inside The Big Red Boat, The Box comes to visit the Twirlywoos. There are strange noises coming from the open box. Chickedy and Chick jump inside to investigate. Great BigHoo and Toodloo join them inside too. The Box suddenly jumps about and The Twirlywoos all leap out but there is still a strange noise coming from The Box. What could it be?

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends meet some very cool, feathered friends and learn to fly them. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is taking a trip on an aeroplane... but who is the pilot?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa leaves muddy footprints on a rug but magically makes them disappear by singing. Meanwhile, the children in Tummy Tales enjoy a squelchy walk through mud with bare feet.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Connor, Bonnie, Ian, Dhilan, Addi, Gracie and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Wooden Spoons which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate wooden spoons inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The popular nursery rhyme ‘Little Miss Muffet’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft rainsticks, learn British Sign Language signs for thunder, wet and raindrops, then sing and sign the stormy rhyme, I Hear Thunder.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Nelly and Adrian explore the wonderful world of plants that live in the shade, with some help from resident shady plant, Fearny the fern.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Baby rhino Malaika tries something new to eat. Hamza spots some huge hippos in the wild and helps the baby zebras at the orphanage stay cosy with some warm blankets.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri learns an incredible secret about her beloved rock.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is blowing up balloons for Tino the artistic mouse's birthday. The Squirrels are a little worried because Tino can be a bit grumpy! But Duggee persuades them all to go and see Tino and give him a bunch of balloons. When you give a tiny mouse a big bunch of balloons, something unexpected happens. Tino starts to float up into the sky! He's having a rather good time, until he gets stuck in a tree. It's time for the Squirrels to come to his rescue.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Purple is the host of a fun game show called Name That Colour, with Pink and Brown playing along as contestants.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Carlson wants to find out all about little owls in today’s episode. Chantelle and some new friends get up extra early to see if they can spot some little owls in the park, whilst Rory meets a bird expert who is tagging more little baby owls. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of Carlson’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, little owls are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and her friends pretend to be little owls as they flap and fly around the park, making up their own special calls.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: We meet five-year-old Henry and his family: Mummy, Mama, and little sister Sophie. There’s lots of fun in store with a breakfast boogie and a visit to a farm. Back at home, they have some bouncy fun on the trampoline, and they find a tiny visitor in need of rescuing. But will they get the ladybird to safety?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Small is making a mess in the kitchen and her raisins are everywhere. They have a visit from Maeve the Mountaineer and cook her some rock cake mountains.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Dan the border collie is a search and rescue dog who works with his owner Jamie. His super nose follows scents and smells like clues so they can rescue people who need their help. Dan is busy digging a hole when his owner Jamie gets a very important phone call – police officer Penny needs them to go to Woofton Woods to look for a lost birdwatcher who is out trying to spot a rare bird, the Woofton woodpecker. After locating the birdwatcher’s car, Dan has to find the scent to discover which of the many paths she has taken through the woods. But the scent takes them off the path and into the canopy of trees, which are full of low-hanging branches and logs. Jamie kits Dan up with his breeze-busting bell so that he can hear him in the thicker forest. But after tracking down the lost birdwatcher, Dan and Jamie head back to the car park only to discover her car is still there. The birdwatcher has gone missing again! Can Dan and Jamie complete a double rescue?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s the start of a new day, and Wren has made a card for her best friend Emmy. Outside, Wren, Emmy and Ayat discover a ladybird, which soon flies away. They go in search of their new fluttery friend, but will they be able to find it? Later, it’s Solomon’s turn to sit at the VIP table as he has been doing so well at school, and he chooses Lusungu as his guest. Finally, Sophie has a fun activity for Wren, Solomon and Lusungu - they are going on a pretend train trip in search of dinosaurs.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Miss Berrington, Evie's new school teacher, and teaching assistant Mr O'Donnell have come to meet Evie at home before term starts, and Waffle is under strict instructions to be on his best behaviour. But Waffle is teething, and won't stop chewing everything in sight.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: The friends are excited to stay with Marvin at the Bat Cave - it's going to be so much fun! When they get to the cave, the bats are sound asleep, hibernating for the winter. The friends must be very quiet so they don't wake them up - but it's difficult to keep quiet when everyone's playing together.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee is desperate to meet the worms that live in the soil beneath the garden. Learning that they only come out when it rains, Yukee tries to simulate the sound before realising that it’s the rhythm that the worms really love.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are bored. It's been raining for what seems like forever and they really want to play outside! They have exhausted the ideas for playing indoors. Now that it is completely quiet in the house, they discover some sounds they have never noticed before. The duo shrink down and explore a treasure trove of new sounds.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fred and Dana's door makes a squeaky sound, so they call the Piggy Builders to fix it. The Piggies decide to upgrade the entire door. They build the greatest door ever, but then forget how to open it.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Twelve and friends go on a spectacular space mission to save Numberland from the mysterious Block Star. Learn how to split numbers into equal groups with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: When T's tip-top new top hat blows away, it's time for some hat chasing to get it back before the big tea party. This episode has fun with '-ap' and the words hat, fan, pet, bat, zap, yap and tap.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble tries to keep quiet, as Grandad Tumble is sleeping. Justin and his friends do some quiet and loud dancing!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Laa-Laa and Po laugh themselves silly with a funny joke, but when they tell it to Dipsy, it doesn't tickle Dipsy in the same way. But Dipsy's funny dance does and when Dipsy dances again, the Teletubbies all laugh together. In Tummy Tales, children have fun being silly in a park.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy meets the ankylosaur, the armoured tank of the dinosaur world, when he travels back in time 70 million years on a mission to replace a broken museum artefact. On his trip he must contend with two fearsome predators - a giant relative of the T-rex and a sneaky pack of velociraptors.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the ‘I am five’ badge and remembers the day she got it… It’s a special day for James. Things haven’t always been smooth sailing, but James reminds Alice that although there are mix-ups, everyone works really hard to make things better.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing recycling machines. First she takes a recycling truck for a spin, then shows off a rubbish collection boat and finally moves loads of metals in a huge recycling materials handler.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Dodge brings some homemade doggy biscuits into the school. He shares them among his friends, but then there's only one left. Who should get the last biscuit? The pups decide that the only fair way to choose who should win it is by showcasing their talents.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: After Love Monster volunteers Monster Teddy to pose for everyone's paintings, he realises he misses him when they are apart. In the end, Love Monster can't take it anymore and poses with Monster Teddy so they can be together.

programme.desc: The Octonauts help a colony of honeybees that are trapped in a sinking tree.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter tries to get the last plum from Mr McGregor's tree, he finds that a mysterious thief has beaten him to it!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When a mysterious creature splashes around Sweetwood, Popcorn thinks it must be a monster.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team must battle to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's earth-shaking stomping performance at the Veg-O-Vision Song Contest.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy sends the Ducklings to bed, but they want to keep watching TV. They find an invisibility ray and use it to stay up without Weasy seeing - but he soon catches on to their scheme!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: It’s hard enough for Mojo and Bo to help Jackson get all his sheep back in their pen, but it’s even harder when the hungry sheep start chewing up Preston’s flower festival!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend to show Mum and Dad who’s boss.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Gadabout and Pearl need Zog's help to catch a stink beetle for an urgent cure. Little do they know, Zog has become a taxi for the gnomes.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When Jen is carried away by a weather balloon, Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to rescue her. Along the way, they meet the mighty Alamosaurus, a gigantic dinosaur that's as long as two double-decker buses! It comes to their aid when they get trapped on an island by an ancient crocodilian, called Deinosuchus, lurking in the surrounding waters.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi and Finn find a lost baby sparrow in the park. Wanting to help, Rafi wishes she could talk to animals. Suddenly, ants, squirrels and Teacup the dog begin to chatter at once, making things more confusing! Rafi realises that listening can be more important than talking. She and Finn close their eyes and hear the sparrow’s mummy calling. Guided by the sound, they find the nest and reunite the chick with its family.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are enjoying a canal walk when they meet Ned and Monty, who need some help. Ned’s looking for the lock key, so they can take their canal boat through the lock and along the canal. JoJo decides she and Gran Gran can help with the search – where could the key be? And how can they get moving quickly enough to solve the canal traffic jam that’s building up? It’s time for a Gran Gran plan.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Cake is tired of living in the fridge, so Sarah and Duck help him think about where else he would like to stay.

programme.desc: A meteor shower of gemstones falls on the planet. Baby Soup Dragon beats Tiny and Small in a game to win them. The others continue the game without him and his stones, and he realises that there is more fun to be had in playing than just winning.

programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa have fun spotting the Yummies, who are popping up all over BeddyByes. At Play Time, the Yummies pop up and disappear again whilst MeMo and BaBa play with a beepy horn. They take it to Yummy Land, where the Yummies explain that they are looking everywhere for Yummy Dog. MeMo and BaBa help to look, beeping the horn as they go. Yummy Dog hears the horn and is reunited with the Yummies.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Children's show about a magic place inhabited by toy characters. Travel with Igglepiggle to the magical night garden. Upsy Daisy teaches Igglepiggle how to play hiding. Upsy Daisy is very good at hiding. Igglepiggle is impressed.

He cannot reach it and goes off to get another cloth, taking the helmet with him. Great BigHoo manages to fall inside the armour and Toodloo jumps in after him - Chickedy and Chick soon follow! What fun will the Twirlywoos have in the suit of armour? Back inside The Big Red Boat, The Box comes to visit the Twirlywoos. There are strange noises coming from the open box. Chickedy and Chick jump inside to investigate. Great BigHoo and Toodloo join them inside too. The Box suddenly jumps about and The Twirlywoos all leap out but there is still a strange noise coming from The Box. What could it be?

Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Wooden Spoons which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate wooden spoons inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The popular nursery rhyme ‘Little Miss Muffet’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of Carlson’s questions. After locating the birdwatcher’s car, Dan has to find the scent to discover which of the many paths she has taken through the woods. Jamie kits Dan up with his breeze-busting bell so that he can hear him in the thicker forest. programme.title: Olivia & Alex: Parenthood
programme.desc: Love Island’s Olivia & Alex Bowen invite us behind the scenes of family life as they juggle careers and parenting, while struggling to find quality time together as a couple. After early scans raised the excitement of expecting twins, the episode begins with an emotional appearance on Loose Women, where they describe their experience of Vanishing Twin Syndrome. As the birth of their daughter grows closer, Olivia feels the strain of daily life, while Alex’s decision to enter a bodybuilding competition couldn’t come at a busier time. Their 3-year-old son Abel provides endless laughs and challenges, from chaotic early mornings, to heart-melting moments at his swimming lessons. Through all the ups and downs, Olivia and Alex’s playful banter shines, especially when Alex’s carelessness threatens to derail their romantic Paris getaway. Honest, warm and full of heart, this is not just reality TV — it’s a candid, funny and deeply relatable look at love, loss and modern family life.

Elsewhere, Gatsby and Dani's relationship is going from strength to strength and Gatsby is finally ready to pop the question and ask Dani to be his girlfriend - this needs to involve a big gesture in true Gatsby style, but will he be able to pull off the surprise of his life and secure himself a girlfriend?
